purpose: Review the approved historical-batch policy kernel and owned development-only evaluation-plan preparation against fixed independent expectations and concrete adverse probes.

conclusion.scope: Policy arithmetic, bounded profile membership, immutable plan preparation, source execution binding and data/access boundary; no scientific readiness or empirical verdict.

fixed_expectations.provenance: Authored before viewing the new policy implementation from research-contract/1.0 sections 5, 12 and 14 and blueprint interface context. No fixture bytes changed during implementation review.

resolved_findings.reproduction: quantile([1/(2**8190-1),1/(2**8190+1)],1/2) raised raw integer-string ValueError; basic_interval(point=2**8191-1, replicates=[-(2**8191-1)],alpha=1/20) returned an 8193-bit endpoint rejected by its own input reader.
resolved_findings.remediation: Check the 8192-bit normalized numerator/denominator envelope before serializing policy arithmetic; reject with typed resource failure and no returned partial interval.

resolved_findings.finding: Wrong raw-close unit admitted to the return profile
resolved_findings.reproduction: Changing the BTCUSDT close definition's unit from USDT/BTC to BTC still admitted the 24h return profile.
resolved_findings.remediation: Require the exact symbol-qualified raw-close identity, matching real type and price unit; do not infer membership from ratio output or a close-like label.

resolved_findings.finding: Canonical request did not govern later calculation
resolved_findings.reproduction: A caller-owned dependence mapping was changed after admission: persisted request retained base_length4 while the plan used base_length8, seed999 and an unvalidated replacement diagnostic reference.
resolved_findings.remediation: Bind all validation, dependency gathering, child input and final commitment to the canonical detached request copy.

resolved_findings.finding: Unavailable diagnostic cases accepted as a basis
resolved_findings.reproduction: A genuine retained development execution remained accepted as diagnostic basis after its case blob was corrupted or removed.
resolved_findings.remediation: Verify the exact committed case-blob binding, SHA256 and size before dependency use and again before final commitment.

resolved_findings.finding: Import-time disk hash did not establish executed source
resolved_findings.reproduction: In a temporary copied package, import evaluation_policy, replace its file, then import evaluation_plans: current disk footprint equaled LOADED_SOURCE while the bound draft_plan function was the old import. No project source was modified.
resolved_findings.remediation: Execute calculation and independent exact replay in separate fresh -I -S -B children from retained copied source; bind request/result hashes, full source footprint and runtime; recheck sources and dependencies before commit.

checks.details: Two numeric-envelope variants and wrong raw-price unit reproduced; the other nine methods passed.
81 fixed kernel cases; 10 allocation-state cases explicitly skipped as future integration.

Eight independent methods plus four root methods unintentionally discovered through a class import. The test harness was corrected to import the support module. Failures were request/caller mutation and missing/corrupt diagnostic case blobs. Pre-fix integration source hash was not captured.

checks.details: Only an isolated temporary copy was changed; root workspace files were untouched.
Includes empty child response, altered delta rejected by actual exact replay, injected cancellation/timeout with no pending attempt, rollback, stale parent imports and all earlier admission fixes.

coverage_qualifications: All real owned-plan fixtures create authenticated source/data/feature/reference/formalization/compilation/development-execution records. They use a synthetic Boolean claim, not a discovered market hypothesis.

Protected-data denial is exercised through deliberately injected trusted snapshot metadata and spies that fail on dependency/blob access. No assessment formalization or protected data access was manufactured.
Caller mutation uses a deterministic dependency-call hook to expose the same mutable-alias window that a concurrent local caller could exploit.
Source mismatch and parent-import isolation use mocks or a temporary package; project runtime source is not edited.
The new malformed-response test mutates the first real child result's delta and relies on the second real retained replay to reject it.

New cancellation and timeout tests inject KeyboardInterrupt/TimeoutError at evaluation_plans._run_child to verify no false plan and no pending attempt. Actual process kill/reap behavior belongs to the existing shared launcher tests and was not newly re-proven by these injected exceptions.
The transaction rollback test injects failure before commit and checks absence of a visible artifact/reservation before a successful retry. It is not a power-loss test.
Plan family size remains provisional; the ten independent allocation-state fixtures are not claimed exercised by this draft seam.
remaining_limits: No actual independent semantic model/human judgment was performed. A mapping assertion or another process is not proof of natural-language equivalence.

No stationary-block bootstrap sampler, narrow calibration result, information target, valid assessment interval, scientific freeze, atomic batch allocation or protected execution/publication authority is established by this slice.
Feature/source replay does not establish historical PIT truth or scientific data/exposure acceptance. Availability assumptions remain qualified.
Separate exact replay checks deterministic response integrity using the same implementation. It is not a different statistical estimator or independent proof of scientific validity.
Parent authentication, metadata/hash validation, input copying, source staging and final integrity checks lie outside each child process timeout.
Maximum-size datasets, worst-case artifact-scan latency, memory/disk exhaustion and machine power loss were not benchmarked in this review.
The trusted host/operator and OS remain outside the hostile-code threat model; runtime binaries are fingerprinted rather than archived.
An existing idempotent draft is historical retrieval, not automatic renewed scientific readiness or a refreshed validation claim.

An interrupted plan attempt durably records kind, compiled input identity, time and terminal status. Its exact request key/dependence payload and source capsule are committed only for a completed draft/gap, so this interruption log alone cannot replay the exact failed calculation.

source_evidence.timing: Captured immediately before the final11-method integration run and after it; the final14-method kernel check ran alongside the after-capture. No source/test changes occurred between the captures.

documentation_review.finding: Matches bounded implementation and explicitly separates policy draft/source verification from scientific admission, actual semantic review, calibration and freeze.
